theme: A clear calendar with two booking windows running out.
greeting: Almost nothing on the calendar today, Dan — just the 9 o'clock, now behind you. These are good open hours to close the two travel bookings that are nearly out of runway.

needsAttention.title: The Maine Christmas SUV is the one that sells out
needsAttention.detail: The p1 on your board, overdue since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — book it refundable now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: December trip books by Thursday
needsAttention.detail: Your board set book-by Oct 15 for the three-week December break with all four girls, and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. Two days left to settle a destination.

needsAttention.title: OECD governance meeting invite
needsAttention.detail: A governance contact wrote this morning asking you to come to the OECD corporate-governance meeting in November and to compare notes — waiting to hear back.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia wants a date to talk
needsAttention.detail: She's back from Morocco on Oct 31 and asked you to put a slot on the calendar; the ball is in your court.
